## What's new

### Work with several agents
- **Prompt queue** (`Ctrl+Shift+K`, `Cmd+Shift+K` on macOS): line up the
  next prompts for a pane while its agent is working. One is delivered each
  time the agent finishes a turn, and never into a permission prompt or menu.
- **Broadcast input** (`Ctrl+Shift+B`): type into every visible terminal of
  the workspace at once. A clear on-screen indicator shows while it is on,
  and it is always off after a restart.
- **Reopen closed pane** (`Ctrl+Shift+Y`): the last 5 closed terminal panes
  can be brought back for 10 minutes, with their scrollback and agent session.
- **Closing asks first** when the pane (or workspace) has a running agent or
  queued prompts.
- **Restart in place**: a pane whose shell has exited can be restarted with
  Enter.
- **Fan-out "Keep this one"**: merge the winning lane into the base branch
  and clean up the other lanes' worktrees and branches. A conflict check runs
  before anything is touched.
- **Switch account near a usage limit**: a badge and an inbox entry offer to
  continue on another account that still has headroom. This starts a fresh
  session; an optional hand-off note can be sent to the new agent.
- **Workspace tree**: shows how long each agent has been in its current
  state and the tool it is running, plus a "stuck" badge.
- **Sending to a pane in another workspace** no longer switches workspaces;
  a toast lets you jump there.

### Settings and notifications
- **Agent tracking self-test**: one click in Settings checks the hook
  receiver, the installed hooks in every account folder and the Claude Code
  version.
- **Daily digest** for webhooks (opt-in per destination): one summary message
  per day. It never includes prompt or assistant text.
- Image paste and file drop into WSL panes now type a `/mnt/<drive>/...` path.

### Usage view
- Totals are no longer limited to the most recent ~256 MB of session logs.
  All history is indexed, in the background and incrementally, and large
  files are included. Expect "all time" numbers and hero levels to jump
  after the first run; hero levels above 100 now cost progressively more.
- Usage history is kept even after old session logs are deleted or cleaned
  up by Claude Code.
- No more "Loading" flicker on refresh. An "Indexing history... N%" line
  shows progress on the first run.

### Microsoft Store build
- Pasted images, the Git Bash startup file and the "open folder" buttons now
  use the real file location, so they work on a fresh Store install.
- New managed accounts live under `~/.ymux/accounts` (existing ones stay
  where they are). Removing an account moves its folder to the Recycle
  Bin/Trash and is refused while a terminal still uses it.
- The Store build no longer shows the GitHub update banner.

### Fixes
- `Ctrl+Shift+W` right after switching workspaces could close a pane in the
  previous, hidden workspace. Close, rename, zoom and find now always act on
  the pane you see, and the active pane is focused after a keyboard switch.
- Global shortcuts no longer fire behind Notes, Settings, the command
  palette or dialogs.
- macOS: `Cmd+Shift+Z` (zoom pane) was swallowed by the Edit > Redo menu
  item. Not yet verified on a Mac; please report if it still fails.
- Office "approve all" only answers plain yes/allow choices. It no longer
  picks options that grant standing permissions ("don't ask again",
  "bypass", "trust"...).
- Restored scrollback no longer starts with broken escape fragments, and
  scrollback is saved during continuous output and on quit.
- Splitting during startup could spawn a shell twice, and a slow shell
  profile could garble the startup command.
- Moving a folder across drives no longer leaves a half copy behind on
  failure.
- Agent tracking: failed tool calls are now reported, duplicate hooks are
  removed on install, and local summarizer/webhook requests no longer go
  through a system proxy.
- Activity log redaction covers more token formats and key names.
- Newly installed shells appear without re-detecting manually.
- Many smaller fixes in the office view, editor drafts, git timeouts and
  settings saves.

### Upgrade notes
- Shells are re-detected once after upgrading.
- The prompt-queue, broadcast and reopen shortcuts are new; see
  Settings > Shortcuts.
